# Token Monitor v0.62.0 contract samples

These input and expected JSON files are fixed, reviewable contract examples, not
output generated by Cloud Monitor's vendored normalization code. The source
contract is Javis603/token-monitor commit
`dcccfb01557e2786888fd5479552f392ac6c0d32` (v0.62.0):

- `docs/API.md`: device records, sessions, token components, History and limits.
- `src/shared/limitProviders.js`, `src/shared/limits/core.js`: provider IDs, daily
  windows, reset-credit grants and third-party usage summaries.
- `tests/shared/usage.test.js`: canonical `micode` → `mimo`, `kilocode` → `kilo`.
- `src/shared/hubBuildRegistry.json`: the fixed core 54 / Node adapter 4 identity.

Only clock placeholders (`$NOW`, `$TODAY`, `$TOMORROW`, `$MONTH`, `$NEXT_MONTH`)
are replaced at test time so expiry does not make tests age out. The old-store
fixture also substitutes `$OLD_CLIENT` to exercise both renamed client IDs.
It models the version-1 devices.json shape before the rename, deliberately
without new capabilities, session fields or history. Updating a cumulative
snapshot from 100 to 150 must retain 150, not append the old alias's 100 again.

`PRIVATE SESSION TEXT` is synthetic test data that must never appear in the
stored device record. No real account details, API keys or session content are
included. Expected values are maintained independently of make_payload.js.
